snippet.title: The Dungeon Experience Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Join a determined mudcrab on a quest to help you achieve true financial freedom. This absurd first-person comedy adventure combines fantasy antics, unexpected surprises, and plenty of laughs.

Developed by Jacob Janerka, Simon Boxer, and Bone Assembly, published by Devolver Digital.

#TheIndiePremier #GameShowcase #IndieGames #TheDungeonExperience
